Name: Calculate Expression
Description: Evaluates mathematical expressions supporting basic arithmetic, parentheses, and common math functions

Name: Run Ad-hoc Query
Description: Executes a read-only SQL SELECT query for ad-hoc purposes with security validation. Supports {{query:"CategoryPath/QueryName"}} composition macros — the composition engine resolves these into CTEs before execution, enabling reuse of saved queries. Ensures SELECT-only operations, prevents dangerous SQL operations, enforces timeouts, and logs all queries for audit trail.

Params.Name: AnalysisRequest
Params.Description: Optional analysis instructions for the LLM to analyze the query results. When provided, the results will be analyzed according to these instructions. Example: 'Summarize the top 5 products by revenue' or 'Identify any anomalies in the data'.

Params.Name: ColumnMaxLength
Params.Description: Maximum length for column values in characters. Values longer than this will be trimmed with '...' suffix to save context. Use when querying tables with verbose text/JSON fields (e.g., PromptText, Description). Example: 50 = trim to 50 characters. Default: 50. Set to 0 if you want FULL column results. Applies to both CSV and JSON formats.

Params.Name: DataFormat
Params.Description: Format for data output: 'csv' (comma-separated values - more token efficient) or 'json' (structured objects). Default: csv. CSV format significantly reduces token usage by avoiding field repetition in every row.

Params.Name: IncludeExecutionPlan
Params.Description: Whether to include query execution plan for performance analysis. Default: false.

Params.Name: MaxRows
Params.Description: Maximum number of rows to return. Default: 1000. Helps prevent overwhelming results from large tables.

Params.Name: Query
Params.Description: SQL SELECT query to execute (required). Only SELECT statements are allowed. Query is validated for syntax and security before execution.

Params.Name: ResultFormat
Params.Description: Format for results: 'json' (structured objects), 'csv' (comma-separated values), or 'table' (formatted text table). Default: json.

Params.Name: ReturnType
Params.Description: What to return: 'data only' (just query results), 'analysis only' (just LLM analysis), or 'data and analysis' (both). Default: 'data and analysis' if AnalysisRequest is provided, otherwise 'data only'. This parameter is ignored if AnalysisRequest is not provided.

Params.Name: Timeout
Params.Description: Query timeout in seconds. Default: 30. Prevents long-running queries from blocking resources.

Name: Get Entity Details
Description: Returns complete field information and sample data for a specific entity. Shows field names, types, descriptions, primary keys, related entities, and a few rows of actual data (3 by default, max 10, long values truncated). Perfect for understanding entity structure before writing SQL queries.

Params.Name: EntityName
Params.Description: Exact name of the entity to get details for (required). Must match the entity's full Name exactly, including any 'MJ: ' prefix (e.g., 'MJ: AI Agents', not 'AI Agents'). If unsure, consult your entity catalog or the 'Get Entity List' action if available.

Params.Name: IncludeRelatedEntityInfo
Params.Description: Include information about entities referenced by foreign keys. Default: true.

Params.Name: SampleRowCount
Params.Description: Number of sample rows to return. Default: 3, maximum: 10. Long field values are truncated to keep results compact. Helps understand actual data in the entity.

Params.Name: UseSemanticSearch
Params.Description: When the entity is not found and simple name matching yields no suggestions, run a ranked semantic search over the entity catalog and suggest the top 3 conceptually related entities in the error message. Default: false.
